COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 2284 of 2024
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Vikas Pandey, learned counsel for the 
petitioners.
2. The grievance of the petitioners is that petitioners 
were engaged on contractual basis in the year 2002, 
however, in the year 2023 they have been discontinued 
on the ground that posts against which they were 
working on contractual basis are not sanctioned. In 
paragraph 15 and 16 of the writ petition, learned 
counsel for the petitioner has given reference of other 
States wherein similarly situated incumbents have been 
either regularised or absorbed. He further made a 
reference of the order passed by the Telangana High 
Court in identical matter wherein the Telangana High 
Court directed the Telangana Government to continue 
those incumbents, who were decided to be disengaged 
by the Telangana Government. He further submits that 
in different States, similarly situated incumbents were 
adjusted in other posts under the same project. He 
further submits that the project is still continuing.
3. Mr. R.S. Bisht, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State accepts notice on behalf of respondent no. 1.
4. Mr. Rahul Consul, learned counsel, accepts notice 
on behalf of respondents no. 2 and 3 through V.C.. 
5. Issue notice to respondent no. 4 by registered 
post acknowledgement due.
6. Steps be taken with a week.
7. Mr. Rahul Consul, learned counsel for the 
respondents no. 2 and 3, shall get instructions about the 
averments made in paragraph 15 and 16 of the writ 
petition, as well as shall apprise this Court why same 
benefit should not be given to the petitioners, as given 
by the High Court of Telangana. 
8. List on 12.12.2024, as fresh.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 03.12.2024
SKS

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSB 775 of 2024
Hon’ble G. Narendar, C.J.
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Vikas Pande, Advocate, for 
the petitioner. 
Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, Brief Holder, 
for the State/respondent no. 1.
Mr. Rahul Consul, Advocate, for 
the respondent no. 2 and 3.
Mr. Manoj Kumar, Central Govt. 
Standing Counsel, for the respondent no. 4.
(2) Learned Counsel for the 
petitioners submits that petitioner no. 1 and 
2 were appointed, after selection, as 
Computer Literate Steno and Divisional 
Assistant respectively in the year 2002 and 
in view of their work and conduct, they 
were appointed on higher post of Assistant 
Director and they have been serving 
continuously under Uttarakhand State Aids 
Control Society for the last more than two 
decades. Petitioners are aggrieved by 
termination of their service. 
(3) Mr. Rahul Consul, learned 
Counsel appearing for the respondent no. 2 
and 3, submits that petitioners were 
appointed on contract, which was extended 
from time to time. He submits that posts, 
on which petitioners were serving, have 
now been abolished by National Aids 
Control Organisation, therefore petitioners’
appointment was discontinued. 
(4) Learned Counsel for the 
petitioners submits that in other States, 
persons holding similar designations are 
continuing and services of as many as 354 
persons, serving under State Aids Control  Society in Manipur, have also been 
regularised. He thus submits that the act of 
respondent no. 2 in terminating services of
petitioners is arbitrary and illegal. 
(5) Since petitioners have put in 
continuous service of more than two 
decades and there is no adverse material 
against the petitoiners, therefore, having 
regard to the long services rendered with 
Uttarakhand State Aids Control Society by 
petitioners, we provide that till the next 
date of listing, petitioners shall be permitted 
to serve on the same position as before and
they shall also be paid the remuneration, as 
they were getting earlier.
(6) Counter affidavit filed on behalf of 
respondent no. 2 and 3 are taken on 
record. Application (IA/2/2024) made 
therefor stands disposed of. Other 
respondents may file counter affidavit 
within four weeks. Rejoinder affidavit to 
counter affidavit of respondent no. 2 and 3, 
if any, be filed within four weeks.
(7) List on 17.3.2025.
(8) Interim relief application 
(IA/1/2024) stands disposed of. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) (G. Narendar, C.J.)
 2.1.2025

UKHC010189922024
WPSB No.775 of 2024
Ramesh Chandra and another …………Petitioners
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and others …………Respondents
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Vikas Pande, learned counsel for the 
petitioners.
2. Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, learned S.C. for the State.
3. Mr. Rahul Consul, learned counsel for respondent 
nos.2 and 3.
4. Mr. Manoj Kumar, learned C.G.S.C. for the Union 
of India/respondent no.4.
5. Mr. Rahul Consul, learned counsel appearing for 
respondent nos.2 and 3 submitted that petitioners were 
engaged in a society which was running a project on 
behalf of National Aids Control Organization; he submits 
that the petitioners were engaged upto Fourth Phase 
which came to an end on 31.03.2021; the funds provided 
for Third Phase dried up and consequently the contract 
of the petitioners was not renewed after 31.03.2023.
6. Mr. Vikas Pande, per contra, learned counsel for 
the petitioners submits that Fourth Phase started from 
the year 2013 and as per the stand taken in the counter 
affidavit the Fourth Phase lasted till 31.03.2021 and the 
posts were abolished in the Fourth Phase, however 
petitioners continued to serve on contract till March, 
2023.
7. He further submits that five persons serving  against the posts are mentioned in the tabular form:
Sr. 
No.
Name Post
1. Dr. Amit 
Shukla
Additional Project Director
2. Mr. Jaswant 
Singh Bisht 
Stores Officer
3. Mr. Pradeep 
Hatwal
Assistant Director (Quality￾BTS)
4. Mr. Surendra 
Singh Bisht
Accountant
5. Mr. Harish 
Negi
Messenger
8. Thus it is contended that the allegation that funds 
have dried up after 31.03.2023 is not correct and if 
funds have dried how come the aforesaid five persons are 
still working on contract.
9. He further submits that all the petitioners want is 
that they should be engaged against any post which is 
available in the project and they are not insisting that 
they should be continued in the same position which 
was held by them earlier.
10. Mr. Rahul Consul to get necessary instructions and 
file a supplementary affidavit if need be.
11. List this case on 24.07.2026. 
 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 10.07.2026 10.07.2026
